curriculum.title: Reading Revelation and Comparing Millennial Views

core.big_idea: Premillennial, postmillennial, and amillennial readings turn on genre, sequence, symbolism, and wider canonical judgments.

passages.reading_note: Read in immediate context; select age-appropriate portions without changing the claim.

core.metanarrative_position: Apocalyptic hope: Eschatology within the History, Hope, and Independent Faith cycle

claims.statement: The selected passage supplies the main textual evidence central to Reading Revelation and Comparing Millennial Views.
Premillennial, postmillennial, and amillennial readings turn on genre, sequence, symbolism, and wider canonical judgments.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not present any one of the premillennial, postmillennial, or amillennial readings as the settled or required position.
claims.interpretive_hinge: Whether Revelation 20 is read as sequential or symbolic, and how much weight its genre carries against wider canonical judgments, is what separates the premillennial, postmillennial, and amillennial readings.

claims.statement: The curriculum does not make a particular millennial scheme a fellowship test; it prioritises the clearer canonical claims of Christ’s victory, resurrection, judgment, and final hope.
claims.interpretive_hinge: Revelation 20 is symbolically dense and historically disputed, whereas resurrection, judgment, and Christ’s victory are taught repeatedly across clearer canonical texts.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not present this framework conclusion as an explicit biblical command or quotation.

core.interpretation_skill: Evaluate sources and arguments; identify assumptions; compare credible positions; state uncertainty precisely

learning.foundation_objective: Analyse the relevant text and explain the case that premillennial, postmillennial, and amillennial readings turn on genre, sequence, symbolism, and wider canonical judgments.
learning.extension_objective: Test the claim against context, genre, canonical synthesis, credible alternatives, and the limits of the available evidence.
know: Premillennial, postmillennial, and amillennial readings turn on genre, sequence, symbolism, and wider canonical judgments.
The lesson belongs in Apocalyptic hope.
understand: Direct observation must remain distinct from interpretation, synthesis, framework position, historical context, and application.
practise: Retell or analyse the passage using evidence from the text.
Name one faithful response without claiming more than the evidence supports.
become: A learner who responds to Scripture with trust, wisdom, worship, service, repentance, love, courage, or humility as appropriate.
success_evidence: Student can summarize the selected passage.
Student can support the big idea with evidence.
Student can distinguish observation from interpretation, history, or application.
